vars.prTitle: Include the user's full name in BasicUserSerializer
vars.prBody: Avatar tooltips (posters, participants, featured users) only have the username to show. Add `name` to BasicUserSerializer so the client can show "Full Name (username)". The name is only sent when it adds information, i.e. it is present and not just the username in a different case.
vars.injectPatch:
diff --git a/app/serializers/basic_user_serializer.rb b/app/serializers/basic_user_serializer.rb
index 1deede2..592a27a 100644
--- a/app/serializers/basic_user_serializer.rb
+++ b/app/serializers/basic_user_serializer.rb
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
 class BasicUserSerializer < ApplicationSerializer
-  attributes :id, :username, :avatar_template
+  attributes :id, :username, :name, :avatar_template
+
+  # Only send the full name when it adds something over the username,
+  # so avatar tooltips can show "Full Name (username)".
+  def include_name?
+    object.name.present? && object.name.downcase != object.username.downcase
+  end
 end
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "BasicUserSerializer's subclasses inherit the new `name` attribute and `include_name?`, but TopicPostCountSerializer (app/serializers/topic_post_count_serializer.rb) does not serialize a User: its object is a Hash `{user: ..., post_count: ...}` built in TopicViewSerializer#details, and it works only because it overrides id, username and avatar_template to read `object[:user]`. It does not override name/include_name?, so `object.name` is called on a Hash and raises NoMethodError while serializing participants, breaking every topic page that has posts (TopicsController#show renders details with participants). The subclass needs `def name; object[:user].name; end` and a matching include_name?, or the base contract must not assume `object` is a User. (Related: TopicPosterSerializer serializes users loaded by AvatarLookup with `select([:id, :email, :username])`, where `name` raises ActiveModel::MissingAttributeError on topic lists.)", "severity": "High"}]
